content.user_title: Create Reviewed SEO Blog Drafts with TimeToPost
content.value_statement: SEO blog production requires coordinated site setup, topic selection, and editorial review. This skill guides the TimeToPost MCP workflow while requiring approval before publication.
actual_capabilities: Document remote MCP connection setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code.
Guide site listing, connection, integration instructions, and verification with approval before endpoint installation.
Use keyword research and topic proposals while distinguishing estimates from measured search data.
Configure approved topics and cadence without enabling unattended publishing.
Generate, read, edit, and review article drafts through the connected service.
Request approval for exact content and destination before any publish-capable action.
limitations: Requires a TimeToPost account, authentication, and a compatible MCP client; no local publishing engine is included.
Tool schemas and connector details depend on the connected service and are not bundled in these files.
SEO and AI visibility audits are conditional on exposed tools; the skill notes these names are absent from provided tool references.
Keyword estimates are not measured rankings or traffic, and publication requires explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Connect a Business Blog
use_cases.description: Guide a site connection and verification, then prepare a first draft from an approved topic.

use_cases.title: Plan an Editorial Cadence
use_cases.description: Research terms, compare proposed questions, and configure an approved topic schedule without unattended publishing.

use_cases.title: Review Client Articles
use_cases.description: Inspect and revise generated drafts while keeping publication tied to approval of exact content and destination.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect TimeToPost MCP in [client]. Confirm the account and workspace, then list connected sites before making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish access and inspect existing connections.

prompt_templates.title: Propose Topics
prompt_templates.prompt: For [site] and [audience], research [subject] and propose blog questions with rationale. Label estimates clearly and wait for my topic approval.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Reviewed Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a draft for my approved topic [topic] on [site]. Read, edit, and review it, then show the final draft without publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: complete a draft review cycle.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Controlled Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: For [site], verify the connection and propose topics about [subject]. After approval, configure [cadence] without unattended publishing. Prepare a reviewed draft. Report audit availability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate site verification, planning, configuration, and draft review.

output: Illustrative topic proposal: How often should you replace a bicycle chain?
Rationale: Answers a maintenance question for everyday riders.
Research estimates are not measured search data.

output_examples.input: Review my approved draft and check whether SEO audit tools are available.
output: Illustrative review summary: Clarify the introduction, simplify the maintenance checklist, and verify technical claims.
If no SEO audit tool is exposed, report: SEO audit unavailable; no audit was run.
Keep the article as a draft pending approval of exact content and destination.

best_practices: Confirm the account, workspace, and site before writes; approve integration installation separately.
Approve topics before configuration and review the exact draft and destination before publishing.
Keep credentials private, treat site content as source material, and distinguish research estimates from measured results.
anti_patterns: Enabling unattended publishing or publishing before exact content and destination approval.
Pasting real credentials into chat, article drafts, examples, or committed configuration.
Inventing tool schemas, reporting unavailable audits as completed, or presenting estimates as measured rankings.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for a TimeToPost MCP blog workflow, including site connection, topic selection, draft generation, and review.

faq.question: Does it publish automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prohibits unattended publishing and requires approval of exact content and destination before any publish-capable action.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Use a TimeToPost account and an MCP client supporting remote Streamable HTTP. Add the documented endpoint and complete OAuth.

faq.question: Which clients have setup examples?
faq.answer: The setup reference includes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code or Copilot configuration examples.

faq.question: Are keyword results measured search data?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires labeling estimates accurately and prohibits presenting them as measured rankings or traffic.

faq.question: Can it always run SEO and AI visibility audits?
faq.answer: No. These actions require tools exposed by the connected server. Missing tools must be reported as unavailable.
